Our story

Good Vibes Café started as a tiny corner stall with one grinder and a big idea: coffee should feel like a hug. Today we roast our own beans, bake daily and keep the playlist just right.

Every cup is poured by baristas who know your order, with beans bought straight from family farms we visit each year.
